title: Within-company response to national growth
statement: Companies earn higher ROA in years when national GDP growth is higher.
effect_unit: pp ROA per +1 pp GDP growth (within company)
notes: Primary: +1 pp national GDP growth → -0.038 pp of the company's own ROA (95% CI -0.154 to +0.077), wild p = 0.569, 34 countries, 7,689 company-years.
Robustness: predicted sign in 29% of seven samples. ESEF replication: +0.216 pp (wild p = 0.032), same direction.
Slow variables (development, institutions) are almost fixed within a country (1% and 0% of variance within), so they cannot be tested this way.
Country-level change in GDP growth vs change in median ROA: ρ = -0.16 (n = 33).
